Kontagora Emirate Legacy Foundation

Preserving our past. Securing our future.

"A foundation rooted in heritage, growing toward tomorrow."

We work to unite and empower the people of Kontagora Emirate — protecting our history, investing in young people, and building lasting community development.

See our work Our achievements

Vision & mission

Our vision

To build a united, peaceful, empowered and prosperous Kontagora Emirate where our people have access to opportunities, and every generation contributes meaningfully to sustainable development.

Our mission

To preserve and promote the unity and historical values of Kontagora Emirate while empowering young people, supporting education, providing humanitarian assistance, and fostering partnerships that advance sustainable socio-economic and community development.

What we do

Cultural Heritage, Peace & Unity

Preserving and promoting the history, traditions, customs and cultural values of Kontagora Emirate while fostering unity, peaceful coexistence and social cohesion among communities.

Youth Empowerment & Education

Supporting scholarships, mentorship, leadership development, skills acquisition, entrepreneurship, career development, seminars and workshops that equip young people with knowledge and real opportunity.

Community & Humanitarian Support

Initiating and supporting projects that address community needs, and providing humanitarian assistance to vulnerable, disadvantaged and underserved individuals and communities.

Economic Empowerment

Promoting entrepreneurship, agriculture, small businesses and vocational skills that encourage self-reliance, employment, innovation and sustainable socio-economic development.

Partnership, Advocacy & Research

Collaborating with government, traditional institutions, NGOs and development partners — conducting research, advocacy, summits and public programmes that advance the Foundation's objectives.

Recent program

One Day Public Lecture on Security Awareness and Heroes Recognition — the Foundation brought together traditional leaders, security agencies and members of the public for a lecture on community security, followed by an award ceremony honouring local heroes for their service to Kontagora Emirate.

Campaign awareness against drugs and illicit substances

The Foundation is running a community awareness campaign against drug abuse and illicit substances in Kontagora Emirate, working with young people, traditional leaders and security agencies to educate the public on the dangers of substance abuse and to encourage a drug-free community.
